project: Learn With Mrs. B: ESOL Coloring & Activity Masterclass

style_rules: 100% Pure Black and White Line Art (#111 on #fff)
Zero Grayscale Fills, Zero Halftones, Zero Charcoal Shading
Multimodal ImagePaths Photo-Conditioning Required (No Text-Only Approximation)
Continuous Enclosed Contour Outlines for Crayons/Markers (1.5pt - 3.5pt)
